summary: iSpecimen Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Consulting Agreement with IR Agency LLC on August 12, 2026. The consultant will provide marketing and news distribution services for three months, up to ten releases, for a non-refundable $2,000,000 cash fee due by August 13, 2026. This is a paid investor-relations/promotion arrangement, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms apply. Watch for promotional activity and potential volatility in ISPC shares.
